items.textAlternative: Read How was your day? in a downloaded lesson. Identify one question that invites another person’s perspective, then ask it without needing a travel video.

items.prompt: Use the official trailer to identify who is traveling together; no need to watch the full film.
items.textAlternative: Read a downloaded Everyday dialogue and identify who is speaking to whom. Describe their situation in English; no historical film or unfamiliar dialect is required.
